question: Does restoring native reward/value loss gradients through frozen heads selectively remove the existing source23/seed31 cascade-vs-random return gap when only dynamics parameters change?
scope: One previously used development root; methodology qualification of a researcher-defined offline-checkpoint adaptation. No Goal change, new attack, native full learner, fixed-candidate ranking or generalization claim.

design.source_data: Existing random/cascade real 300-transition caches; no recollection.
design.optimizer: Fresh Adam lr=3e-4, clipping20, H3, batch32; same saved CUDA batch-index bank.
design.frozen_parameters: Encoder, reward, online/target Q, actor, task embeddings, all remaining model state.
design.added_loss: Native soft_ce reward and TD-value losses, coefficients0.1/0.1, through frozen heads into predicted latent states; detached native targets from fixed true successor encodings.
design.mode: eval, unchanged from original dynamics-only adaptation; not full native joint training.
design.target_rng: Per-update forked CPU/current-CUDA seed314159+u, shared across sources, restored after native target sampling.
design.candidate_boundary: Closed-loop native planner: subsequent candidate/trajectory changes are downstream effects; candidates are not held fixed.

historical_reconstruction.limitation: Matching every learning log and the full return does not independently prove equality to unavailable historical adapted parameters. Newly adapted dynamics weights are saved.

runtime_checks.observation: These frozen-state and gradient checks are runtime assertions; independent review can inspect their implementation/logs without claiming a second full-state measurement.

statistics.unit: One previously used development root, paired by seed, source-specific data and minibatch bank.
statistics.method: Descriptive factorial contrast only; no population confidence interval, p-value or ASR.

go: The original source23/seed31 conditional return gap is exactly reproducible under the original adaptation.
Restoring these frozen-head task-loss paths changes the source contrast on this development case.
no_go: The prespecified selective-recovery test fails: the random-source comparator degrades7.917%, and cascade gain is below half the original gap.
A smaller between-source gap is not sufficient to claim a useful defense.
No proof of non-normality, malicious source intent, unique prediction-error mediation, Goal-Bus decision harm or independent generalization.
decision.next_action: Archive this completed qualification and stop its automatic expansion. Do not tune coefficients, choose another seed or reinterpret the failed gate as defense success. A new pilot needs a substantive unresolved mechanism and a separately stated control.

execution.adaptation_training: 1200 small dynamics-only updates in four arms; this is training and must not be described as zero-training.

independent_review.evidence_boundary: Returns, shapes, paired initial observations, recording equality, historical log comparisons, and decision criteria were independently recomputed. Frozen-state equality and first-batch backward-gradient checks are verified runtime attestations from the reviewed runner; frozen non-dynamics tensors were not saved, so they are not independently rehashed or re-executed here. Historical weights were not saved either.
